card.name: Digits and spaces before numbers in dosing
card.fires_on: The digit or space right before the next number in dosing tables and ranges, such as 'to' then a space before 60, or the 0 in 600 mg. It also fires on section-number digits like 5 in 5.4.

modes.label: Space before a range number
modes.description: A space after 'to' or 'than' just before the upper number of a range or cutoff.

modes.label: Digit inside a dose number
modes.description: A digit partway through a dose figure in a dosing table.

modes.label: Section number digit
modes.description: The leading digit of a label section reference like 5.4.

card.writes: The promoted words (community) look unrelated to the pattern, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to give a number in a dose table or range, like the 60 in '5 to 60 minutes'.
